title: QROS shared definitions
description: Closed vocabularies and shared primitives referenced by the other QROS 2.0.0 schemas. Enforces the vocabularies fixed by SPEC.md; defines no rule of its own. SPEC.md is the sole normative source. The v1 definitions, including the retired review-transport primitives, are frozen under retired/v1/schemas/ and are never used for new work.

Identifier.description: A durable identifier. Opaque to the schema; uniqueness is a project concern.

Date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date, used for dated obligations.

Digest.description: Lowercase hex content digest, 32-128 hex characters.

RoleBinding.description: Which concrete party filled a QROS role. Binding role to party is project configuration (QROS-ROLE-VENDOR-BINDING-IS-CONFIG); a record of what actually happened names the concrete party. The schema constrains shape only, never vendor.

Role.description: QROS roles (QROS-ROLE-OWNER, QROS-ROLE-DELEGATE, QROS-ROLE-BUILDER). Closed. The DELEGATE is optional; where none is appointed the OWNER holds the delegated gates.

Party.description: A role together with the concrete party that filled it (QROS-ROLE-VENDOR-BINDING-IS-CONFIG).

Lane.description: QROS-AXIS-LANE. Governs which claims work may emit (QROS-LANE-CLAIM-SCOPE), and nothing else.

LifecycleStage.description: QROS-LIFECYCLE-STAGES. A project may alias these names in configuration, recorded (QROS-CONFIG-CONFIGURABLE); the canonical set is closed.

ExposureLevel.description: QROS-AXIS-OUTCOME-EXPOSURE. A missing record means UNKNOWN, never NONE (QROS-EXPOSURE-MONOTONIC). UNKNOWN is treated as potentially exposed.

ExposureRecord.description: Exposure is recorded per object and per party (QROS-AXIS-OUTCOME-EXPOSURE), so both party and target are required. Exposure is monotonic: once revealed, never regressed (QROS-EXPOSURE-MONOTONIC).

BlindnessLevel.description: QROS-BLIND-LEVELS, with respect to a named outcome.

ResearchStatus.description: The research-status half of a verdict (QROS-VERDICT-VOCABULARY). Closed. When in doubt, not_promoted. There is no insufficient-evidence value; use unresolved.

Disposition.description: The disposition half of a verdict (QROS-VERDICT-VOCABULARY). Closed.

ReviewVerdict.description: QROS-REVIEW-VERDICTS. Exactly two values: PASS (move on; never widens scope) and HOLD (requires a blocking finding; buys one bounded repair).

AcceptanceOutcome.description: QROS-REVIEW-VERDICTS: the outcomes of DELEGATE acceptance in the delegated S2 loop.

EvidenceClass.description: QROS-REVIEW-EVIDENCE-CLASSES. SELF-REPORTED never passes and never blocks on its own (QROS-REVIEW-SELF-REPORTED-NOT-BLOCKING).

FindingClass.description: QROS-REVIEW-BLOCKING-REQUIREMENTS. Only BLOCKING holds; the others become backlog rows.

ThreatClass.$comment: Closed at each version (QROS-THREAT-VOCABULARY). Not a configuration surface (QROS-CONFIG-TIGHTEN-ONLY).

BlockerClass.description: QROS-BLOCKER-CLASSES. Closed; every blocker has exactly one. Only CURRENT_PATH_BLOCKER and ARCHITECTURE_LEVEL_BLOCKER hold a project.

OwnerGate.$comment: Closed list (QROS-GATE-OWNER-RETAINED). Not a configuration surface (QROS-CONFIG-TIGHTEN-ONLY). Exercised or granted by the OWNER directly (QROS-GATE-NO-RELAY).
OwnerGate.description: The five actions only the OWNER performs or grants.

DelegatedGate.description: The decisions of QROS-GATE-DELEGATED, decided by the DELEGATE informed by the BUILDER. The OWNER may take any of them back; where no DELEGATE is appointed the OWNER holds them.

ChangeLabel.description: QROS-CHANGE-LABELS. Closed; every post-seal change carries exactly one. IMPLEMENTATION_FIX and DATA_FIX are decided by the BUILDER; the other three by the DELEGATE.

IndependenceDimension.description: The four dimensions of QROS-INDEP-FOUR-KINDS. Only EMPIRICAL supports a replication claim (QROS-INDEP-REPLICATION-REQUIRES-EMPIRICAL).

IndependenceStatement.description: Independence stated per dimension and per target (QROS-INDEP-STATE-PER-DIMENSION). Silence about a dimension means UNKNOWN.
